main.description: Run Sentinel scene analysis (change detection / land use / SAR flood) via RunPod Serverless GPU endpoint, persist result as com.etzhayyim.apps.maps.satelliteAnalysis record. LangChain orchestrates COG retrieval + RunPod invoke + structured JSON parse. ADR-2604271800.

sceneUri.description: AT URI of the satelliteScene record to analyze (at://did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com/com.etzhayyim.apps.maps.satelliteScene/{rkey}).

baselineUri.description: AT URI of the baseline scene (required for changeDetection).

modelVersion.description: Pin a specific RunPod worker model version. Falls back to endpoint default.
